newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia IOI to buy stake in Palmco.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia IOI to buy stake in Palmco.

text.p: IOI Corp Bhd said on Monday that it was acquiring a 32.96 percent stake in Palmco Holdings Bhd and another 32.99 percent of the company's warrants from Mega First Corp Bhd for 249.20 million ringgit in cash.
The acquisition, at 4.35 ringgit per Palmco share and 2.00 ringgit a warrant, would provide the IOI group with an opportunity to enter the oleochemical industry, IOI said in a statement.
Palmco is the largest local oleochemical concern in the country. In addition, the company has upstream operations in the form of palm kernel oil production.
IOI group has a plantation land holding of 100,000 hectares in various stages of planting and maturity.
"It is the IOI group's intention to develop a fully integrated palm oil business," the statement said.
Palmco shares were last traded at 3.92 ringgit each and its warrants at 2.15 ringgit before being suspended last Thursday at the company's request pending an announcement.
